name: monaco
title: Monaco code viewer
purpose: Show code blocks as read-only Monaco editors (line numbers, syntax highlighting, theme-aware). Markup: <pre><code data-lang="rust">.

variants.full: standard editor features, languages rust, shell, ini, python, cpp, javascript, typescript, json, yaml, markdown (about 4.7 MB per article)
variants.min: drops find, quick-open, reference search and diff; languages rust, shell, ini, python, cpp (about 3.4 MB per article)
